# ADR-3086: A08: Insecure deserialization gadget for payload 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unsafe deserializers execute attacker gadgets.

## Decision

Services MUST NOT perform an insecure deserialization gadget for payload 2 (A08-2).

## Consequences

Prefer safe formats and allow-listed types.
